providers.name: Galaxy, procedurally generated by scripts/generate-procedural-textures.mjs (no third-party material)

review.note: Checked live (2026-08-26): New Horizons resolved Styx (radius ~5 km) only as a handful of pixels during its single 2015 flyby of the Pluto system — no surface map is possible at that resolution. Procedural texture: bright neutral base with light cratering, reflecting the real >50% geometric albedo measured for Pluto's small moons (unusually high for the Kuiper belt) and their water-ice-dominated composition.
